news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: The company granted 90,000 RSUs and a non-qualified option to purchase 170,000 shares (exercise price $2.12) as a material inducement to a new employee, issued under its Inducement Plan per Nasdaq Rule 5635(c)(4).

news.headline: Director Richard S. Kollender exercises stock options for 3,508 shares
news.summary: RPID director Richard S. Kollender exercised options for 3,508 Class A shares at a $0.75 exercise price, a routine insider transaction.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: The company confirmed it will release Q2 2026 results before market open on August 7, 2026, with a management webcast/conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercises stock option
news.summary: CEO Robert Spignesi exercised a fully vested option for 1,402 Class A shares at $0.75 per share, a routine transaction ahead of the option's August 11, 2026 expiration.

news.headline: RPID affiliate files Form 144 to sell 10,000 Class A shares
news.summary: An insider affiliate (COO John J. Addington Wilson) filed notice to sell 10,000 Class A shares via stock option exercise, continuing a pattern of periodic small insider sales.

news.headline: Form 144 filed by COO John J. Addington Wilson for Class A share sale
news.summary: RPID's Chief Operating Officer disclosed a proposed sale of 3,688 Class A shares, part of a recurring series of small option-exercise-related disposals in June-July 2026.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro Biosystems is scheduled to report Q2 2026 financial results before market open with an 8:30 a.m. ET webcast; as of this research the results had not yet appeared in available news/search sources despite the confirmed schedule. Prior guidance called for Q2 revenue of at least $7.7 million including at least 4 Growth Direct system placements.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report expected roughly three months after Q2, per the company's standard reporting cadence.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 guidance: $37-41M revenue, 30-38 system placements
catalysts.detail: Reaffirmed as of Q1 2026 earnings: total revenue guidance of $37.0-$41.0 million, 30-38 Growth Direct system placements, at least 25 system validations, and gross margin of approximately 20%.

catalysts.label: MilliporeSigma distribution partnership
catalysts.detail: Ongoing distribution agreement with MilliporeSigma intended to accelerate multi-system rollouts and broaden commercial reach for the Growth Direct platform.

pulse: News flow remains quiet and dominated by routine insider Form 4/144 filings (small option exercises and share sales by the CEO, a director, and the COO) plus an August 4 inducement grant for a new hire. The key event is today's (August 7) Q2 2026 earnings release and call, which had not yet surfaced in available sources at the time of this research despite being officially confirmed and scheduled. The stock remains depressed near multi-year lows, with the market's near-term focus on whether Q2 hits the guided ~$7.7M revenue/4+ system placements and whether full-year $37-41M guidance stays intact.
